annotations.title: Remove an athlete from the roster

description: Take an athlete off the roster, as the profile's "Remove from your roster" card does. What it does depends on who they are: an athlete with their own TriPeak login gets the plan back, with every session, race and threshold — they coach themselves from then on, the seat is free, nothing is deleted. An athlete with no login has nobody to hand it to, so removing them DELETES the athlete and everything on their plan, and that cannot be undone: without delete_everything it refuses and says how many sessions would go. Tell the coach that and pass delete_everything: true only once they have said yes. The coach's own plan is never removed. To move an athlete to another coach instead, use hand_off_athlete.

athlete_id.description: May be omitted when you coach exactly one athlete.

delete_everything.description: Only for an athlete with no login, and only after the coach has agreed to the deletion.

name: remove_athlete
